t: 7.9 Mw 特戎要塞地震震撼了中南加州,最大Mercalli烈度为IX (Violent).
te: The 7.9 Mw Fort Tejon earthquake shakes Central and Southern California with a maximum Mercalli intensity of IX (Violen…
dz: 7.9 Mw 特戎要塞地震震撼了中南加州,最大Mercalli烈度为IX (Violent).
de: The 7.9 Mw Fort Tejon earthquake shakes Central and Southern California with a maximum Mercalli intensity of IX (Violent).

t: 加尔各答大学正式成立,是南亚第一所完全成熟的大学.
te: The University of Calcutta is formally founded as the first fully fledged university in South Asia.
dz: 加尔各答大学正式成立,是南亚第一所完全成熟的大学.
de: The University of Calcutta is formally founded as the first fully fledged university in South Asia.

t: 第二次鸦片战争：法国和英国对中国宣战。
te: France and the United Kingdom declare war on China.
dz: 第二次鸦片战争：法国和英国对中国宣战。
de: Second Opium War: France and the United Kingdom declare war on China.

t: 美国最高法院在"德累德·斯科特诉桑德福德"(Dred Scott v. Sandford)案中…
te: The Supreme Court of the United States rules 7–2 in the Dred Scott v. Sandford case that the Constitution does not conf…
dz: 美国最高法院在"德累德·斯科特诉桑德福德"(Dred Scott v. Sandford)案中规则7–2,宪法没有赋予黑人公民权.
de: The Supreme Court of the United States rules 7–2 in the Dred Scott v. Sandford case that the Constitution does not confer citizenship on black people.

t: 艾莉莎·奥蒂斯的首部电梯安装在纽约市百老汇488号.
te: Elisha Otis's first elevator is installed at 488 Broadway New York City.
dz: 艾莉莎·奥蒂斯的首部电梯安装在纽约市百老汇488号.
de: Elisha Otis's first elevator is installed at 488 Broadway New York City.

t: 第34团的塞波伊·曼加尔·潘迪(Sepoy Mangal Pandey),孟加拉土着步兵针对东…
te: Sepoy Mangal Pandey of the 34th Regiment, Bengal Native Infantry mutinies against the East India Company's rule in Indi…
dz: 第34团的塞波伊·曼加尔·潘迪(Sepoy Mangal Pandey),孟加拉土着步兵针对东印度公司在印度的统治而发动了兵变并激励了1857年的持久印度叛乱,又被称作"塞波伊叛乱".
de: Sepoy Mangal Pandey of the 34th Regiment, Bengal Native Infantry mutinies against the East India Company's rule in India and inspires the protracted Indian Rebellion of 1857, also known as the Sepoy Mutiny.

t: 由Allan Kardec所着"精神书"出版,标志着精神主义在法国的诞生.
te: The Spirits Book by Allan Kardec is published, marking the birth of Spiritualism in France.
dz: 由Allan Kardec所着"精神书"出版,标志着精神主义在法国的诞生.
de: The Spirits Book by Allan Kardec is published, marking the birth of Spiritualism in France.

t: 东印度连解散了孟加拉土着步兵第34团,他们之前的塞波伊·曼加尔·潘德伊在印度独立战争前曾反抗英…
te: The East India Company disbands the 34th Regiment of Bengal Native Infantry whose sepoy Mangal Pandey had earlier revol…
dz: 东印度连解散了孟加拉土着步兵第34团,他们之前的塞波伊·曼加尔·潘德伊在印度独立战争前曾反抗英国.
de: The East India Company disbands the 34th Regiment of Bengal Native Infantry whose sepoy Mangal Pandey had earlier revolted against the British in the lead up to the War of Indian Independence.

t: 在印度,第一次独立战争开始. Sepoys在Meerut针对他们指挥官的兵变.
te: In India, the first war of Independence begins. Sepoys mutiny against their commanding officers at Meerut.
dz: 1857年印度起义:在印度,第一次独立战争开始. Sepoys在Meerut针对他们指挥官的兵变.
de: Indian Rebellion of 1857: In India, the first war of Independence begins. Sepoys mutiny against their commanding officers at Meerut.

t: 印度叛军从英国人手中夺取了德里.
te: Indian rebels seize Delhi from the British.
dz: 1857年印度起义:印度叛军从英国人手中夺取了德里.
de: Indian Rebellion of 1857: Indian rebels seize Delhi from the British.

t: 明顿敏被加冕为缅甸国王,位于缅甸曼德勒.
te: Mindon Min is crowned as King of Burma in Mandalay, Burma.
dz: 明顿敏被加冕为缅甸国王,位于缅甸曼德勒.
de: Mindon Min is crowned as King of Burma in Mandalay, Burma.

t: 甘哈多尔人革命从巴西巴伊亚州萨尔瓦多开始.
te: The Revolution of the Ganhadores begins in Salvador, Bahia, Brazil.
dz: 甘哈多尔人革命从巴西巴伊亚州萨尔瓦多开始.
de: The Revolution of the Ganhadores begins in Salvador, Bahia, Brazil.

t: Charles Baudelaire的"花花儿"(Les Fleurs du mal)出版.
te: Charles Baudelaire's Les Fleurs du mal is published.
dz: Charles Baudelaire的"花花儿"(Les Fleurs du mal)出版.
de: Charles Baudelaire's Les Fleurs du mal is published.

t: 维多利亚十字勋章的首个授勋仪式在伦敦海德公园举行.
te: The first investiture of the Victoria Cross takes place in Hyde Park, London.
dz: 维多利亚十字勋章的首个授勋仪式在伦敦海德公园举行.
de: The first investiture of the Victoria Cross takes place in Hyde Park, London.

t: 塞内加尔的法国总督路易·法伊德贝(Louis Faidherbe)抵达克耶斯以解除法国军队,有…
te: Louis Faidherbe, French governor of Senegal, arrives to relieve French forces at Kayes, effectively ending El Hajj Umar…
dz: 塞内加尔的法国总督路易·法伊德贝(Louis Faidherbe)抵达克耶斯以解除法国军队,有效地结束了埃尔哈吉·乌马尔·塔勒对法军的战争.
de: Louis Faidherbe, French governor of Senegal, arrives to relieve French forces at Kayes, effectively ending El Hajj Umar Tall's war against the French.

t: 68人坚守了8天,抵抗了2500至3000名兵变塞波伊和8000名非正规部队.
te: Sixty-eight men hold out for eight days against a force of 2,500 to 3,000 mutinying sepoys and 8,000 irregular forces.
dz: 印度叛乱:68人坚守了8天,抵抗了2500至3000名兵变塞波伊和8000名非正规部队.
de: Indian Rebellion: Sixty-eight men hold out for eight days against a force of 2,500 to 3,000 mutinying sepoys and 8,000 irregular forces.

t: 1857年的恐慌开始,引发了美国历史上最严重的经济危机之一.
te: The Panic of 1857 begins, setting off one of the most severe economic crises in United States history.
dz: 1857年的恐慌开始,引发了美国历史上最严重的经济危机之一.
de: The Panic of 1857 begins, setting off one of the most severe economic crises in United States history.

t: 摩门教定居者屠杀了一列和平出行的火车的大部分成员.
te: Mormon settlers slaughter most members of a peaceful emigrant wagon train.
dz: Meadows山大屠杀:摩门教定居者屠杀了一列和平出行的火车的大部分成员.
de: Mountain Meadows massacre: Mormon settlers slaughter most members of a peaceful emigrant wagon train.

t: 摩门教定居者和Paiutes在犹他州Meadows山屠杀了120名先锋.
te: Mormon settlers and Paiutes massacre 120 pioneers at Mountain Meadows, Utah.
dz: Meadows山大屠杀:摩门教定居者和Paiutes在犹他州Meadows山屠杀了120名先锋.
de: The Mountain Meadows massacre: Mormon settlers and Paiutes massacre 120 pioneers at Mountain Meadows, Utah.

t: 党卫军中美洲号在北卡罗莱纳州哈特拉斯角以东约160英里海域下沉,共有426名乘客和船员被淹死,…
te: The SS Central America sinks about 160 miles east of Cape Hatteras, North Carolina, drowning a total of 426 passengers …
dz: 党卫军中美洲号在北卡罗莱纳州哈特拉斯角以东约160英里海域下沉,共有426名乘客和船员被淹死,其中包括船长威廉·刘易斯·埃尔登. 舰只从加州淘金潮运来13至15吨黄金.
de: The SS Central America sinks about 160 miles east of Cape Hatteras, North Carolina, drowning a total of 426 passengers and crew, including Captain William Lewis Herndon. The ship was carrying 13–15 tons of gold from the California gold rush.

t: 1857年的印度叛乱以忠于东印度公司的军队收复德里而结束.
te: The Indian Rebellion of 1857 ends with the recapture of Delhi by troops loyal to the East India Company.
dz: 1857年的印度叛乱以忠于东印度公司的军队收复德里而结束.
de: The Indian Rebellion of 1857 ends with the recapture of Delhi by troops loyal to the East India Company.

t: 俄国"勒福"号战列舰在芬兰湾的一场风暴中起降并沉没,舰上所有826人全部遇难.
te: The Russian warship Lefort capsizes and sinks during a storm in the Gulf of Finland, killing all 826 aboard.
dz: 俄国"勒福"号战列舰在芬兰湾的一场风暴中起降并沉没,舰上所有826人全部遇难.
de: The Russian warship Lefort capsizes and sinks during a storm in the Gulf of Finland, killing all 826 aboard.

t: 谢菲尔德足球俱乐部(英语:Shefffield F.C.)是目前仍在运营的世界最古老的协会足球…
te: Sheffield F.C., the world's oldest association football club still in operation, is founded in England.
dz: 谢菲尔德足球俱乐部(英语:Shefffield F.C.)是目前仍在运营的世界最古老的协会足球俱乐部,成立于英国.
de: Sheffield F.C., the world's oldest association football club still in operation, is founded in England.

t: 24个维多利亚十字勋章被授予,一天之内最多.
te: Twenty-four Victoria Crosses are awarded, the most in a single day.
dz: 勒克瑙第二次解脱:24个维多利亚十字勋章被授予,一天之内最多.
de: Second relief of Lucknow: Twenty-four Victoria Crosses are awarded, the most in a single day.

t: 维多利亚女王选择渥太华（当时是一个伐木小镇）作为加拿大省的首府。
te: Queen Victoria chooses Ottawa, then a small logging town, as the capital of the Province of Canada.
dz: 维多利亚女王选择渥太华（当时是一个伐木小镇）作为加拿大省的首府。
de: Queen Victoria chooses Ottawa, then a small logging town, as the capital of the Province of Canada.
